title: TextFinder
description: Quickly find a specific item on signs
body:
### This mod is completely coded by AI

_Are you annoyed by searching certain things on signs,leaving your eyes hurt?Then you need this mod._

## Features
Add 3 commands to game
- /tf <keyword> ←start to search
- /td <page number> ←display the search result
- /trf <anotherkeyword> ←search again among the signs already founded

## Config
- outputComplexity：decides how complex messages are.(1~4,default:2)
- maxSearchAmountPerTick：decides how many signs it searches per game tick.(1~10000,default:256)
- searchRange：decides how far it searches(chunks)(1~32,default:12)
